name: Camping "Ferienpark Hainz am See"
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Ferienpark Hainz am See is located in Petting in the federal state of Tirol and is classified as a campsite. It is situated directly on the shore of a swimming lake, which is one of the main attractions of the site. The pitches are divided into plots and some have electricity and water connections. A separate beach area with a play area is reserved for guests. In the surrounding area, cycling tours and walks in the adjacent forest are available. The sanitary facilities are cleaned regularly and are accessible barrier-free.
